components.name: brass_body
components.notes: One continuous shallow rectangular body cage; cylinder/keyway location is deferred because it is not visible on the retained front reference.

components.name: steel_shackle
components.notes: One continuous U-shaped steel shackle with two seated legs; distinct from brass body.
evidence: official 6 mm diameter and 21×22 mm clearance specifications

components.name: front_seam_and_wordmark
components.notes: The retained front view shows a shallow horizontal seam and wordmark in the same brass body surface; create neither a circular front insert nor a separate front assembly.

relationships.notes: Shackle legs seat into two top sockets while remaining a distinct assembly.
The front seam and wordmark are visible body-surface features; no circular front insert is present in the retained front view.

claims.statement: The brass body is a shallow rectangular solid with controlled manufactured edge radii.
claims.modeling_consequence: Start from one cube-derived connected body cage; retain square face planes and add edge radius only after proportion review.

claims.statement: The shackle is an independently manufactured continuous U-shaped steel component.
claims.modeling_consequence: Use one separate curve/path or connected tube for the full shackle; do not fake it with disconnected cylinders.

claims.statement: The U-shaped shackle creates one dominant rectangular-arched opening above the body.
evidence: 21 mm width and 22 mm clearance height specification
claims.modeling_consequence: Treat opening width and height as primary gate constraints before keyway or logo detail.

claims.statement: No circular keyway is visible on the retained front face; the visible lower-front features are a shallow horizontal seam and the Master wordmark.
claims.modeling_consequence: Do not create a circular front insert. Defer the cylinder/keyway until a direct underside or reverse-side reference establishes it.

claims.statement: Exact body depth and rear/underside construction are not established by the retained references.
claims.modeling_consequence: Use a reversible depth hypothesis and do not claim rear fidelity.

claims.statement: The shackle is approximately bilateral across the front vertical centerline.
claims.modeling_consequence: Use mirrored legs or a symmetric curve path for the shackle.

claims.statement: Body width 40 mm; shackle clearance 21 mm wide by 22 mm high; shackle diameter 6 mm.
claims.modeling_consequence: Use these ratios as frozen initial front blockout constraints.

claims.statement: The primary body is a single continuous brass cage, while the shackle is a physically separate assembly. The cylinder/keyway location remains unresolved.
evidence: visible top sockets and material separation in the product reference
claims.modeling_consequence: Model one connected cube-derived body and one continuous separate shackle path. Defer cylinder/keyway construction until its location is directly observed.

strategies.name: box_body_plus_single_curve_shackle
strategies.representation: connected cube-derived body cage + separate editable curve shackle

strategies.name: primitive_assembly
strategies.rejection_reason: It would hide the continuous U-shaped shackle and encourage disconnected body details instead of controlled editable construction.
